tool_args.rationale: The endpoint-matched history gap supports a latent memory state. Because mem_conv is absent, the memory time constant affects both reconstruction from each irregular prefix and propagation to the forecast horizon. The fine trajectory batch targets that parameter ambiguity; the pilot horizons already bracket the target H = 0.45.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the coupled memory ODE to the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All five prefixes use the same switch timing and sampling grid. With one forecast per prefix at similar horizons, the memory time constant and coupling can trade off against each other and the direct relaxation rate.
It cannot account for the reported forecast gap between histories with matched endpoints.
It is cheaper but targets sink-gradient branch ambiguity rather than the memory transient.
